statement: ∀ f g : KdVPlan.Coeff, KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 g → ∀ k : ℤ, Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖ * ‖g (k-j)‖)
proof:
intro f g hf hg k
have hf' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hf
have hg' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hg
have hgk : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g (k-j)‖^2) := hg'.comp_injective (by intro x y h; omega)
apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) _ (hf'.add hgk)
intro j
nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖f j‖-‖g (k-j)‖), norm_nonneg (f j), norm_nonneg (g (k-j))]
